'''Emlyn McFarland''' (born '''Emlyn Elisabeth Williams Morinelli'''), is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is sometimes credited as '''Emlyn Morinelli''', '''Elisabeth Williams''',  '''Anna Morrow''', or '''Emily Williams'''. She is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Pokémon roles==
McFarland joined {{aniseries|PTS}} when {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|took over the dubbing and distribution of the series]]. Her most prominent roles are that of [[Zoey]] and [[Officer Jenny]]. She didn't provide any more voices in the series after the [[S15|fifteenth season]]. However, after a long absence, she finally returned in [[S25|Pokémon Ultimate Journeys: The Series]].
